About this edition ↗

Self-contained, offline CSS animation of 24 depth-buffered ASCII views per bouquet. Select flowers, palette, detail, and rotation speed below. Pause holds the current view. This edition has no live JavaScript orbit, zoom, sliders, or keyboard shortcuts; its opening effect scales the whole bouquet rather than opening individual buds.
